extracted.intended_audience: children's book authors, illustrators, librarians, educators, and readers interested in award criteria
extracted.subtask_description: Criteria and terms used to determine the Randolph Caldecott Medal winner and Honor Books, including eligibility rules (who/what is eligible) and the illustration-focused judging standards used to evaluate picture books for children.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of the award (work type and recipient)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Medal shall be awarded annually to the artist of the most distinguished American picture book for children.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Award is to the artist (illustrator) of a picture book judged 'most distinguished' for children. There are no limitations as to the character of the picture book except that the illustrations be original work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication requirements (publisher, place, language, and timing)
rubrics_metrics.description: Book must be published by an American publisher in the United States in English during the preceding year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only books meeting these publication conditions (American publisher, published in the U.S., English language, and published in the calendar year prior to the award) are eligible for consideration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Originality of illustrations
rubrics_metrics.description: The illustrations must be original work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an explicit requirement: illustrations reproduced, adapted, or not original would not meet eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Artist citizenship/residency eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: The award is restricted to artists who are citizens or residents of the United States.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only U.S. citizens or residents are eligible as recipients of the Medal.

rubrics_metrics.name: U.S. territory/commonwealth publication eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Books published in a U.S. territory or U.S. commonwealth are eligible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publication outside the fifty states but within U.S. territories/commonwealths still satisfies the geographical publication requirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Committee consideration limited to eligible books
rubrics_metrics.description: The committee in its deliberations is to consider only books eligible for the award, as specified in the terms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Committees must screen and deliberate only on works that meet the stated eligibility rules (publication, language, originality, artist status).

rubrics_metrics.name: Honor Book designation (runners up)
rubrics_metrics.description: Honor books may be named; these shall be books that are also truly distinguished.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In addition to the single Medal winner, the committee may designate Honor Books (runners-up) that meet the standard of being 'truly distinguished.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Excellence of execution in artistic technique
rubrics_metrics.description: Illustrations are judged by excellence of execution in the artistic technique employed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess technical skill, mastery of chosen media, craftsmanship, and the quality of the artistic execution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Excellence of pictorial interpretation of story, theme, or concept
rubrics_metrics.description: Illustrations are judged by excellence of pictorial interpretation of story, theme, or concept.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate how well the images interpret, enhance, and convey the story's narrative, themes, or central concepts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appropriateness of illustration style to story/theme/concept
rubrics_metrics.description: Illustrations are judged by appropriateness of style illustration to the story, theme or concept.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider whether the chosen illustrative style fits and supports the book's tone, theme, and intended meaning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delineation through pictures (plot, theme, characters, setting, mood, information)
rubrics_metrics.description: Illustrations are judged by delineation of plot, theme, characters, setting, mood or information through the pictures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess how effectively the pictures convey narrative elements and informational content—do they clarify and advance plot, characterize figures, establish setting and mood, and communicate needed information?

rubrics_metrics.name: Excellence of presentation for a child audience
rubrics_metrics.description: Illustrations are judged by excellence of presentation in recognition of a child audience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate whether the presentation (composition, clarity, visual appeal, readability, tone) is developmentally appropriate and engaging for children.
